summary: Adds server-side PostHog analytics events 'Rule changed' (create/edit/enable/disable via editor, chat, API, MCP), 'Rule deleted' and 'All rules toggled', keyed to the user's account email and carrying only ids/enums; no change to how rules behave (the commit message's pattern-reset changes were dropped in later squashed commits).

statements.why: Analytics wrapped in try/catch, ids/enums only.

statements.text: ◐ Type checking is turned off in 1 spot in apps/web/utils/rule/rule.test.ts (`any`).

misses.what: New analytics: every rule create/edit/enable/disable, rule delete and the all-rules switch now sends an event to PostHog tied to the user's email address (ids and settings only, no rule text or senders).
'Rule deleted' is recorded before the delete runs, so it's logged even if the delete fails.
